observations.what: OutcomePolicy is a frozen dataclass with fields outcome, residual, severity, meaning, verdict.
OUTCOME_POLICY defines specific outcomes: clean, gates_failed, no_change, runner_failed, worktree_failed, cancelled, storage_unavailable.
UNKNOWN_OUTCOME has residual 0.0 and severity 1.0, meaning fail-closed.
instruction_fingerprint uses hashlib.sha256 on instruction string.
_definition_fingerprint includes base_revision, target_paths, and gate in hash if any present; otherwise falls back to instruction_fingerprint.
_candidate_definition_fingerprint extracts gate fields from candidate and calls _definition_fingerprint.
